id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

name.description: The name of the asset class.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

translatedName.description:
**DISPLAY USE ONLY**

The translated display string of the {@link AssetClass#name}.

parentAssetClassRelations.description: The relations to parents for this class.

childAssetClassRelations.description: The relations to children for this class.

countChildren.description: Number of children this {@link AssetClass} has.

hasChildren.description: Indicates whether this asset class has children.

assets.description: All {@link ReliabilityAsset}s of this asset class.

countAssets.description: Number of {@link ReliabilityAsset}s of this asset class.

failureModeLibrary.description: The {@link FailureModeLibrary} associated with this asset class.

failureModes.description: The {@link FailureMode}s associated with this asset class.

countFailureModes.description: Number of {@link FailureMode}s associated with this asset class.

expectedSensors.description:
The {@link ExpectedSensor}s associated with this asset class.
This should be set to be a superset of all the {@link ExpectedSensor}s present on a
{@link FailureModeLineItem} associated with the {@link #failureModeLibrary} of this asset class.

expectedSensorCount.description: Number of {@link ExpectedSensor}s associated with this asset class.

kpis.description:
Metric names or expressions that specify key performance indicators for any asset using this
asset class.

linked3DModel.description:
The {@link ReliabilityAsset3dmodel} that is linked to this asset class.
This is used to link the asset class to a 3D model or image that represents the asset class.

status.description:
Status of the assetClass based on the presence of a linked 3D model.
Returns 'Linked' if the 3D model is associated; otherwise, returns '-'.

hierarchyTemplate.description: Defines the hierarchy that assets using this `AssetClass` should be the root of.

definitionVersion.description:
If this asset class was created from a AssetClassDefinition file, this field contains
the particular version of the definition that was used to create this asset class.

If this asset class has id that starts with {@link ReliabilityAssetClassDefinitionParser#getParentClassIdPrefix}
and this field is null this means that a run of {@link ReliabilityAssetClassDefinitionParser} failed to create
this asset class.

title:
Represents a general class of assets which share similar characteristics and can be modeled in largely the same way.

Can be associated with a common set of {@link ExpectedSensor}s and {@link FailureMode}s which would be associated
with all {@link ReliabilityAsset}s which use this class.

For example, a class of assets might be "Pump" and the expected sensors might be "Flow Rate", "Pressure", etc.
Or a class of assets might be "Furnace" and the expected sensors might be "Temperature", "Pressure", etc.
name: AssetClass
